print.name: Wltoys K969, K989, 284131 Wheel Rims
print.description:
Custom rims (wheels) for Wltoys K969, K989 or 284131. Can be printed with 2 colors without a special multicolor printer. Just add a stop a the right height in the slicer and change the filament during the print.

The holes are very tight, so you have to force them a little bit to get them on. But then they hold really well.
